title: peplis nummulariifolia subsp. borysthenica
intro: Peplis nummulariifolia subsp. borysthenica, commonly known as Borysthenica, is a subspecies of plant in the family Tropaeolaceae. It is a perennial herb native to Eastern Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Borysthenica include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides.
